findings.title: Reject failure on the bound original parent check
findings.detail: The uniquely bound original check result is ignored. Replacing it with FAIL in the owner-neutral scope fixture still returns BOUND_ORIGINAL_CLAIM. This misses required original-field parent contradiction handling; Native-only failure tests do not cover this input. Reject bound failure/conflicting claims and add pre-T negative coverage without inferring verified execution.

findings.title: Bind benchmark component commands to the corresponding check role
findings.detail: The command helper accepts any unique original governance command. A final harness run borrowing the original lint command is accepted after synthetic immutable rebinding, contrary to BINDING_RULES lines149–153. Bind the corresponding original harness/quality check and reference; add a wrong-role existing-command fixture.
